Returns an overall verdict (PASS, REVIEW or FAIL) with verdict_reasons, based on the PASS/FLAG/

tools.description: Get a 0-100 risk score for a carrier by USDOT number or MC/FF/MX docket number, with reason codes (e.g. insurance_lapsed, authority_under_90_days, shared_phone, multiple_contact_changes). tools.description: Evaluate your own load rules against a carrier (by USDOT number or MC/FF/MX docket number) and get eligible, needs_review or ineligible, with each rule's result and reason, plus CarrierVet's unchanged verdict (PASS, REVIEW or FAIL) and risk score. tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Fetch the saved copy of an earlier lookup by its receipt_id: the time it was made, the endpoint, the identifier, and the exact response CarrierVet returned, with its SHA-256. Any API key on the account that made the lookup can read it. Receipts are saved a few seconds after the lookup. Free; does no

tools.name: get_history
tools.description: List changes CarrierVet detected in a carrier's FMCSA record (address, phone, email, authority, insurance, out-of-service), newest first, plus fmcsa_history: dated changes from FMCSA's daily files and census, each with the date FMCSA recorded it, the date CarrierVet saw it, and the before and after

tools.name: search_carriers
tools.description: Find carriers already stored by CarrierVet whose legal or DBA name contains the given text (max 25). Prefer lookup_carrier when you have a USDOT or MC number. Costs 1 lookup.

tools.name: batch_lookup
tools.description: Look up to 500 USDOT or MC numbers in one call from stored snapshots (Pro and Business plans). Each found result includes the same verdict, verdict_reasons and verdict_basis as lookup_carrier. Costs 1 lookup per unique identifier.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Show this API key's plan, lookups used and remaining this UTC month, monitor count and rate limit. Free; does not cost a lookup.

tools.name: list_watchlist
tools.description: List carriers on this account's watchlist (monitors), including each monitor's notification settings and last delivery status.

tools.name: add_to_watchlist
tools.description: Add a carrier to this account's watchlist (paid plans). Change alerts for the carrier's FMCSA record are delivered to the notification email and/or signed webhook (Pro+) configured for this monitor via alert_email and webhook_url. The carrier must have been looked up at least once.

tools.name: remove_from_watchlist
tools.description: Stop watching a carrier on this account.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: lookup_carrier, get_risk, check_load_eligibility, get_history, list_watchlist · Private data: lookup_carrier, get_receipt, get_history, get_usage, add_to_watchlist · Public sink: get_history, add_to_watchlist · Destructive: remove_from_watchlist.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: lookup_carrier, get_risk, check_load_eligibility, get_history, list_watchlist · Private data: lookup_carrier, get_receipt, get_history, get_usage, add_to_watchlist · Public sink: get_history, add_to_watchlist · Destructive: remove_from_watchlist

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_watchlist" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "List carriers on this account's watchlist (monitors) with alert email, webhook and last delivery status." → after: "List carriers on this account's watchlist (monitors), including each monitor's notification settings and last delivery status."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
